title: Three Adults Standing Outside Suburban Home, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot showing a man standing between two women along a concrete walkway in front of a mid-century suburban home. The women wear patterned jackets, dresses, and light-colored shoes, while the man wears a dark polo-style sweater and slacks. In the background, house numbers reading '542' are visible near the porch, with neatly trimmed lawn trees framing the front yard.
